versions.content: On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation() the egress tim e stamp shall be retrieved for t1 from the StbM via StbM_GetCurrent VirtualLocal Time() on egress of the Pdelay_Req message according to Figure 7 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to FALSE .

On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation() with parameter ' Result ' equal to E_OK the egress tim e stamp shall be retrieved for t1 from the StbM via StbM_GetCurrent VirtualLocal Time() on egress of the Pdelay_Req message acco rding to Figure 6 , if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport ( ECUC_EthTSyn_00018 : ) is set to FALSE .

On invocation of EthTSyn_TxConfirmation with parame- ter Result equal to E_OK the egress time stamp shall be retrieved for t1 from the StbM via StbM_GetCurrentVirtualLocalTime on egress of the Pdelay_Req message, if EthTSynHardwareTimestampSupport is set to FALSE.
